name: @glassgrid/desktop
description: Glassgrid desktop app: open multi-GB CSV files locally.
author: Kaleb Kougl

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.integration.json
scripts.e2e:render: cross-env GLASSGRID_RENDER_PERF=1 electron-vite build && cross-env GLASSGRID_E2E_RENDER=1 playwright test
scripts.e2e:render:10m: cross-env GLASSGRID_RENDER_PERF=1 electron-vite build && cross-env GLASSGRID_E2E_RENDER=1 GLASSGRID_E2E_ROWS=10000000 playwright test
